title_as_printed: Apparent Molar Volumes and Compressibilities for Aqueous CaCl2 Solutions at 25 C
property_description: density of the solution minus density of pure water at 25 C (measured, vibrating-tube densimeter); value = printed 10^3 (d - d0) times 0.001 in g/cm3; d0 not tabulated, the builder uses IAPWS-95 water density

value.what: measured density difference d - d0 (printed as 10^3 (d - d0), g-cm^-3)

CaCl2.note: m printed as m; molality defined per kg H2O (Eq. 2 and text: 'n1 is the number of moles of H2O per kg of H2O')

extra_unmapped: -10^4 K_phi (apparent molar adiabatic compressibility, calculated by authors from sound velocity and density, cm3 mol-1 bar-1)
V_phi cm^3-mol^-1 (V_phi, apparent molar volume, derived by the authors from d via Eq. 3)
u - u0 cm-sec^-1 (sound-velocity difference, not a density)
conversion_needs: value2 is d - d0 in g/cm3 times 1e3 as printed: scale 1e-3; absolute density needs the density of pure water at 25 C (not tabulated)
notes: Pure CaCl2 solutions, m = 0.0334 to 7.4000 mol/kg, rows in decreasing m. Printed decimal commas ('5,0004', '3,01') are scan artefacts, read as full stops after checking the image. The paper says the CaCl2 data are less extensive and of lower precision than the NaCl data.
pressure_note: not stated (no pressure given for the vibrating-tube densimeter or sound-velocity measurements)
volume_basis_evidence: apparent molar volume Vphi = V - n1 V1(0) with n1 = moles of H2O per kg of H2O (Eq. 2); density is reported as the difference d - d0 in g cm^-3, no per-volume concentration is tabulated
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Primary measured quantity is the density difference (d - d0), p.862 'primary experimental property (d - do)'; V_phi is derived by the authors. The paper states no pressure, so the rows stay held on 'pressure missing'.
